measurements.evidence_quote: Mean hydrodynamic diameters and zeta potentials were estimated to be, respectively, 41 nm and -40 mV for 40 nm nanoparticles and 204 nm and -43 mV for 200 nm nanoparticles. Zeta potential of the PS nanoparticles was measured in ASTM hard water at pH ~8.0.
